official_title: SP 800-53 Control Overlays for Super Intelligence Systems
former_title: Control Overlays for Securing AI Systems (COSAiS)

use_cases.official_name: Adapting and Using Generative SI – Assistant / Large Language Model (LLM)
use_cases.summary: Securing generative systems and assistants that synthesize text, code, or multimodal content from prompts, RAG corpora, and enterprise context.
Securing statistical and machine-learning systems fine-tuned on historical data to classify, forecast, or score operational decisions.

use_cases.official_name: Using SI Agent Systems (SI Agents) – Single Agent
use_cases.summary: Securing autonomous or semi-autonomous single-agent systems invoking external tools, MCP servers, and APIs to execute multi-step workflows.

use_cases.official_name: Using SI Agent Systems (SI Agents) – Multi-Agent
use_cases.summary: Securing collaborative multi-agent swarms and delegated agent topologies against lateral movement, confused-deputy escalation, and cascade failures.
Establishing secure software, model, and tool-generation engineering practices for SI builders in alignment with NIST SP 800-218 / SP 800-218A (SSDF).
